messageEn: Login successful
messageSw: Umeingia kikamilifu

messageEn: Authentication failed. Please try again.
messageSw: Uthibitishaji umeshindikana. Tafadhali jaribu tena.

messageEn: Invalid username or password. Please check and try again.
messageSw: Jina la mtumiaji au nenosiri si sahihi. Tafadhali hakiki na ujaribu tena.

messageEn: Your account has been locked due to too many failed login attempts. Please try again later.
messageSw: Akaunti yako imefungwa kutokana na majaribio mengi ya kuingia yaliyoshindikana. Tafadhali jaribu tena baadaye.

messageEn: Invalid client credentials. Contact the system administrator.
messageSw: Taarifa za mteja si sahihi. Wasiliana na msimamizi wa mfumo.

messageEn: The provided token has expired. Please log in again.
messageSw: Muda wa tokeni umeisha. Tafadhali ingia tena.

messageEn: Unsupported grant type.
messageSw: Aina ya ombi haitambuliki.

messageEn: Your account has been deactivated. Please contact the administrator for more information.
messageSw: Akaunti yako imesitishwa. Tafadhali wasiliana na msimamizi kwa maelezo zaidi.

messageEn: Please verify your email address before signing in.
messageSw: Tafadhali thibitisha barua pepe yako kabla ya kuingia.

messageEn: Your account is suspended. Please contact the administrator.
messageSw: Akaunti yako imesimamishwa kwa muda. Tafadhali wasiliana na msimamizi.

messageEn: Your account has been blocked. Please contact the administrator.
messageSw: Akaunti yako imezuiwa. Tafadhali wasiliana na msimamizi.

messageEn: Enter your two-factor authentication code to continue.
messageSw: Ingiza namba ya uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili ili kuendelea.

messageEn: Set up two-factor authentication to continue. Your account requires it.
messageSw: Weka uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili ili kuendelea. Akaunti yako inauhitaji.

messageEn: Choose a new password to continue.
messageSw: Chagua nenosiri jipya ili kuendelea.

messageEn: This way of signing in is not available.
messageSw: Njia hii ya kuingia haipatikani.

messageEn: No account is linked to this sign-in. Ask an administrator for an account.
messageSw: Hakuna akaunti iliyounganishwa na njia hii ya kuingia. Omba akaunti kwa msimamizi.

messageEn: Weak password! Use upper and lower case letters, a number and a special character.
messageSw: Nenosiri ni dhaifu! Tumia herufi kubwa na ndogo, namba na alama maalum.

messageEn: Invalid old password
messageSw: Nenosiri la zamani si sahihi

messageEn: Passwords do not match
messageSw: Manenosiri hayafanani

messageEn: New password must be different from your current password
messageSw: Nenosiri jipya lazima liwe tofauti na la sasa

messageEn: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
messageSw: Kiungo hiki si sahihi au kimeisha muda wake. Tafadhali omba kingine.

messageEn: You have used this password before. Choose one you have not used recently.
messageSw: Umewahi kutumia nenosiri hili. Chagua ambalo hujalitumia hivi karibuni.

messageEn: Two-factor authentication is not turned on.
messageSw: Uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili haujawashwa.

messageEn: Two-factor authentication is required for your account and cannot be turned off.
messageSw: Uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili ni wa lazima kwa akaunti yako na hauwezi kuzimwa.

messageEn: Your password is managed by your sign-in provider and cannot be changed here.
messageSw: Nenosiri lako linasimamiwa na mtoa huduma wako wa kuingia na haliwezi kubadilishwa hapa.

messageEn: That code was already used. Wait for the next code and try again.
messageSw: Namba hiyo imeshatumika. Subiri namba inayofuata kisha ujaribu tena.

messageEn: The directory could not be reached.
messageSw: Saraka haikuweza kufikiwa.

messageEn: That session no longer exists.
messageSw: Kikao hicho hakipo tena.
